articles.titleCn: XMerge：跨轴选择与重建层合并，用于大型语言模型深度压缩
articles.abstractCn: 移除完整的Transformer层可以保持标准的推理架构，但现有的深度压缩方法可能会损失大量质量，且这种损失在不同模型中的变化是不可预测的。我们引入了XMerge，这是一种包含两个组件的模型后训练方法。交叉轴选择可以识别出相对幅度和角度隐藏状态变化较小的块，而局部边界重建则重新拟合相邻的存活块以匹配原始两块输出。XMerge无需任务标签或端到端微调，既不引入架构变更，也不增加推理时的额外参数。在七个Llama和Qwen主干网络（0.5B-8B）上，五个已发表的基线模型，以及三种层压缩级别中，其相对于基线的优势在最大程度的移除时最为显著：在k=4时，它在CORE（一个22任务聚合）上对七个主干网络中的六个排名第一，同时在MMLU上对七个主干网络中的六个分别排名第一（在两者同时上对七个主干网络中的五个排名第一），同时避免了几个竞争算子带来的较大困惑度增加。在任务级别的引导测试中，三个最大的CORE优势的95%置信区间不包括零；其余优势与平局一致。在14个（模型，策略）单元中，它也是唯一一个从未崩溃的评估算子，在零样本和情境学习策略中均排名前二；在一个初始校准测试（一个主干网络）中，它是校准最好的算子。消融实验表明，局部重建提供了大部分增益，而交叉轴融合在两个选择轴不一致时有所帮助。额外的构建成本通过每千个请求后的解码节省大致得到弥补。

articles.title: Transfer Safety Awareness for Cross-Modal Safety Drift in Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Visual modality enhances the capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) but also introduces a safety concern: a benign textual query may convey harmful intent when grounded in a visual image. We term this cross-modal safety drift and our pilot studies show that the safety response rate for such requests is substantially lower than that for requests containing explicitly unsafe text. This paper aims to systematically study this issue. First, we conduct an empirical analysis to identify representative unsafe response patterns. Building on these, we interpret model representations and attentions, revealing that visually risky cues receive limited attention and weakly trigger refusal. Motivated by the observation that safety signals from unsafe text processing can be transferred, we propose safety-awareness representation transfer (SRT), a lightweight direction-refinement method that mitigates cross-modal safety drift with a frozen MLLM backbone. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and models show that SRT effectively improves safety in diverse cross-modal settings while preserving utility. Code is available at https://github.com/cucu220123/safety-awareness.
articles.titleCn: 多模态大语言模型中跨模态安全漂移的迁移安全意识
articles.abstractCn: 视觉模态增强了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的能力，但也引入了安全风险：一个良性的文本查询在基于视觉图像时可能传达有害意图。我们将此现象称为跨模态安全漂移，初步研究表明，此类请求的安全响应率远低于包含明确不安全文本的请求。本文旨在系统地研究这一问题。首先，我们进行实证分析以识别具有代表性的不安全响应模式。基于这些模式，我们解释模型表示和注意力机制，揭示视觉风险性线索受到的注意力有限且难以触发拒绝。受“不安全文本处理的安全信号可迁移”这一观察启发，我们提出了安全意识表示迁移（SRT），这是一种轻量级的方向细化方法，通过冻结MLLM主干网络来缓解跨模态安全漂移。跨多个基准和模型的实验表明，SRT在保持实用性的同时有效提升了不同跨模态场景下的安全性。代码可在https://github.com/cucu220123/safety-awareness获取。

articles.title: HyGRAIL: Cost-Aware and Evidence-Grounded Scientific Hypothesis Discovery over Knowledge Graphs
articles.abstract: Scientific knowledge graphs organize entities and relations extracted from scientific literature, but they remain inherently incomplete. Missing typed links in such graphs can therefore represent plausible scientific hypotheses, such as unexplored associations between materials and applications. However, scientific hypothesis discovery is challenging because true discoveries are extremely sparse among typed candidate pairs: graph neural networks (GNNs) are efficient but unreliable for ambiguous cases, while large language models (LLMs) are knowledgeable but too costly to apply exhaustively and are not naturally grounded in graph structures. We propose HyGRAIL, a cost-aware and evidence-grounded framework that combines heterogeneous GNN triage with LLM-based hypothesis review. HyGRAIL first uses a GNN to score candidate hypotheses and identify a validation-calibrated ambiguous region, routing only graph-uncertain cases to LLM review. For each routed hypothesis, HyGRAIL retrieves node-level associations and multi-hop relational paths from the knowledge graph (KG), then converts this structured evidence into natural language through template-based or LLM-based naturalization. An LLM review agent finally judges each hard hypothesis using the naturalized evidence and validation-selected decision criteria. On MatKG, HyGRAIL achieves the best F1 score of 0.429, improving over the strongest prior baseline by 0.242 F1 points and over the GNN-only baseline by 0.322. Meanwhile, GNN triage reduces the LLM call rate by 54.36% on average. Ablation studies further show that retrieved graph evidence is crucial for reliable hypothesis verification and that compact, two-sided evidence is more effective than simply increasing retrieval quantity.
articles.titleCn: HyGRAIL：基于知识图谱的成本感知与证据驱动的科学假设发现
articles.abstractCn: 科学知识图谱通过从科学文献中提取实体和关系进行组织，但它们本质上仍然是不完整的。因此，此类图谱中缺失的带类型链接可以代表合理的科学假设，例如材料与应用之间尚未探索的关联。然而，科学假设发现具有挑战性，因为真实发现在带类型候选对中极为稀少：图神经网络（GNN）在高效性方面表现出色，但在模糊情况下不可靠；而大型语言模型（LLM）知识丰富，但应用起来成本过高，且并非自然地基于图结构。我们提出了HyGRAIL，这是一个成本感知且基于证据的框架，它结合了异构GNN筛选与基于LLM的假设审查。HyGRAIL首先使用GNN对候选假设进行评分，并识别出经过验证校准的模糊区域，仅将图不确定的情况路由至LLM审查。对于每个路由的假设，HyGRAIL从知识图谱（KG）中检索节点级关联和多跳关系路径，然后通过基于模板或基于LLM的自然化将这种结构化证据转换为自然语言。最终，LLM审查代理使用自然化证据和验证选择的决策标准来评判每个困难假设。在MatKG上，HyGRAIL实现了最高的F1分数0.429，比最强的先前基线提高了0.242 F1分，比仅GNN基线提高了0.322。同时，GNN筛选平均将LLM调用率降低了54.36%。消融研究进一步表明，检索到的图证据对于可靠的假设验证至关重要，而紧凑的双向证据比单纯增加检索量更有效。

articles.title: Privacy Washing: Detecting Internal Contradictions in Privacy Policies
articles.abstract: Privacy policies may contain internal contradictions in which commitments are undermined by practices documented elsewhere in the same policy. We operationalize this phenomenon, privacy washing, through a four-stage pipeline: statement extraction, compatibility filtering and natural language inference screening, multi-model judge verification, and thematic analysis, with contradictions confirmed by majority vote of a three-model LLM panel. Applied to two corpora of website privacy policies, 123 collected in 2026 (OPPT) and 115 collected in 2015 (OPP-115), the pipeline finds the same category patterns recurring across the 11-year gap, with third-party sharing contradictions the majority of confirmed cases in each primary run, consistent with structural factors in policy composition rather than necessarily intentional deception. At least one panel-confirmed contradiction appears in 12.2% of OPPT companies (15/123; 9.8% excluding legacy pairs) and 36.5% of OPP-115 companies (42/115). A stability re-run seven months later, with a fully separated configuration (new extraction models, judges from three Chinese providers absent from both corpora, matched filters, no judge-submission similarity threshold), reproduces the OPPT prevalence under the original protocol (13.0% vs. 12.2%), finds sub-threshold pairs confirm at rates of the same order as those above (raising prevalence to 20.3% and 40.9%), and shows the third-party majority is panel-sensitive while the recurrence of the same category pairs is not. Two caveats govern all figures: panel verdicts are not validated against human expert judgment, so precision is unknown and prevalence figures are lower bounds; and the two primary runs used different filter configurations, so their prevalence difference is not interpretable as a corpus or era effect (the matched re-run reduces the gap to roughly twofold but does not eliminate it).
articles.titleCn: 隐私清洗：检测隐私政策中的内部矛盾
articles.abstractCn: 隐私政策可能存在内部矛盾，其中某些承诺因政策中其他地方记录的实践而被削弱。我们通过一个四阶段管道来操作化这一现象——隐私漂白：声明提取、兼容性过滤和自然语言推理筛选、多模型判断验证，以及主题分析，矛盾由三模型大型语言模型小组多数投票确认。应用于两个网站隐私政策语料库，2026年收集的123份（OPPT）和2015年收集的115份（OPP-115），管道发现11年间的相同类别模式反复出现，第三方共享矛盾是每次主要运行中确认案例的大多数，这与政策构成的结构性因素一致，而非必然的故意欺骗。至少有一个小组确认的矛盾出现在OPPT公司中的12.2%（15/123；排除传统配对的为9.8%）和OPP-115公司中的36.5%（42/115）。七个月后进行的稳定性重运行，采用完全分离的配置（新的提取模型、两个语料库中均未包含的三家中国供应商的判断者、匹配的过滤器、无判断者提交相似度阈值），在原始协议下重现了OPPT的流行率（13.0% vs. 12.2%），发现低于阈值的配对确认率与上述相同（将流行率提高到20.3%和40.9%），并显示第三方多数是小组敏感的，而相同类别配对的重复则不是。所有数据均受两个限制：小组裁决未与人类专家判断验证，因此精确度未知且流行率数据是下限；两次主要运行使用了不同的过滤器配置，因此它们的流行率差异不能解释为语料库或时代效应（匹配的重运行将差距缩小到约两倍，但并未消除它）。

articles.title: A Tri-Agent Framework for Evaluating and Aligning Question Clarification Capabilities of Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in interactive systems where understanding user intent precisely is paramount. A key capability for such systems is effective question clarification, especially when user queries are ambiguous or underspecified. This paper introduces a novel tri-agent framework for the robust evaluation of an LLM's ability to engage in clarifying dialogue. Our framework comprises three distinct LLM-based agents: (1) a Question Clarifying Agent (QCA), the system under evaluation, tasked with identifying ambiguities and posing clarifying questions; (2) a Respondent Agent (RA), designed to simulate human user responses, potentially including irrelevant or challenging replies; and (3) an Evaluator Agent (EA), an LLM-as-a-judge, which assesses the quality of the dialogue based on a comprehensive set of metrics. We detail a methodology for synthetic data generation in the supply chain domain as an example. We propose metrics evaluating ambiguity handling, question quality, dialogue efficiency, language appropriateness, and final intent alignment. We also briefly discuss the validation of the EA against human judgments. This work provides a structured approach to benchmark, validate, and improve the clarification capabilities of conversational LLM applications.
articles.titleCn: 一个用于评估和校准大型语言模型问题澄清能力的三代理框架
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地部署在交互系统中，其中精确理解用户意图至关重要。对于此类系统而言，有效的提问澄清是一项关键能力，尤其是在用户查询模糊或未明确的情况下。本文介绍了一种新颖的三代理框架，用于对LLM进行鲁棒的澄清对话能力评估。我们的框架包含三个不同的基于LLM的代理：（1）提问澄清代理（QCA），即被评估系统，负责识别模糊点并提出澄清问题；（2）应答代理（RA），设计用于模拟人类用户回复，可能包括不相关或具有挑战性的回答；（3）评估代理（EA），作为裁判的LLM，根据一套全面的指标评估对话质量。我们以供应链领域为例，详细阐述了合成数据生成的方法。我们提出了评估模糊处理能力、问题质量、对话效率、语言适当性和最终意图一致性的指标。我们还简要讨论了EA相对于人类判断的验证情况。这项工作为基准测试、验证和改进对话式LLM应用的澄清能力提供了一种结构化方法。

articles.title: The Dynamics of Continuous Mixture Collapse in Language Models
articles.abstract: LLMs latent-state reasoning methods replace discrete intermediate tokens with continuous states, such as weighted mixtures of token embeddings, to retain multiple possible reasoning directions rather than committing to one. Yet pretrained language models often fail to preserve these mixtures. We study why through a combination of theoretical analysis and controlled empirical investigations on a variety of models. We identify three independent, distinct sources of failure. First, transformer architectures already distort mixture geometry, and training substantially amplifies this effect. Moreover, the failure can occur even if the model transports mixtures perfectly linearly: the softmax readout and autoregressive feedback form a dynamical system that either amplifies small differences until one component of the mixture dominates or contracts different mixtures until they become indistinguishable. We verify this theoretical prediction empirically: the observed transition between contraction and amplification occurs near the theoretical threshold derived by our analysis, and pretrained-model rollouts lie predominantly on the amplifying side. Finally, we generalize to mixtures of many components and show that exact preservation generally requires context-dependent correction, whose required dimensionality can grow with the number of components.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型中连续混合坍塌的动力学
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的潜在状态推理方法用连续状态（如嵌入的加权混合）替换离散中间标记，以保留多种可能的推理方向，而不是只选择一个。然而，预训练语言模型往往无法保留这些混合。我们通过理论分析和在各种模型上的受控实证研究来研究其原因。我们确定了三个独立且不同的失败来源。首先，Transformer架构已经扭曲了混合的几何形状，而训练会显著放大这种效应。此外，即使模型完美地线性传输混合，失败也可能发生：softmax读出和自回归反馈形成了一个动力系统，该系统要么放大微小差异直到混合中的一个成分占主导地位，要么收缩不同的混合直到它们变得无法区分。我们通过实证验证了这一理论预测：收缩和放大之间的观察到的转变发生在我们分析推导的理论阈值附近，预训练模型的展开主要位于放大的一侧。最后，我们推广到包含多个成分的混合，并表明精确保留通常需要依赖于上下文的校正，其所需的维度可能会随着成分数量的增加而增长。

articles.title: How Output Format Confounds Data Quality and Capability in Instruction Tuning
articles.abstract: Instruction-tuning data are judged by quality metrics, and tuned models are judged by benchmarks, but both judgments pass through an output interface: the surface format in which an answer is written. Using gradient signatures across 12 tasks, four semantically equivalent interfaces, three model families, and controlled corruptions, we show that this interface confounds both measurements. Spectral statistics such as effective rank are provably invariant to interface rotation and empirically blind to semantic corruption, while the direction of the update carries the quality signal. The interface-varying residual is not noise: it identifies each unit's own target task perfectly across all three families. Capability itself is stored relative to the training interface: a skill that raises accuracy by more than 40 points under the training format can be nearly invisible under every other, and correcting a single generation budget flips the measured effect of fine-tuning on GSM8K from a gain into a large loss. Pre-registered interventions delimit where this geometry stops short of control. Data quality and model capability are interface-conditioned quantities, and current practice often reports the interface instead of the content.
articles.titleCn: 输出格式如何混淆指令微调中的数据质量和能力
articles.abstractCn: 指令调优数据通过质量指标进行评估，而调优后的模型则通过基准测试进行评估，但两种评估都需经过一个输出接口：即答案呈现的表面格式。通过跨12项任务、四种语义等价接口、三种模型家族以及受控的损坏，我们证明该接口混淆了两种测量。谱统计量如有效秩被证明对接口旋转不变，且在经验上对语义损坏具有盲点，而更新方向则携带了质量信号。随接口变化的残差并非噪声：它完美地识别了每个单元在所有三个家族中的目标任务。能力本身是相对于训练接口存储的：一项在训练格式下能将准确率提高40多分的技能，在其他任何格式下几乎都难以察觉，而修正单个生成预算则会使微调对GSM8K的测量效果从增益转变为巨大损失。预先注册的干预措施界定了这种几何结构在何种程度上偏离了控制。数据质量和模型能力是受接口条件制约的量，而当前实践往往报告接口而非内容。

articles.title: Train What You Deploy: Closing the MLP Reachability Gap in Low-Rank Clone Distillation
articles.abstract: A compressed student has two shapes that need not agree: the weight it deploys at inference and the weight family its training can reach. We show that a state-of-the-art weight-inheritance distiller, Low-Rank Clone (LRC), deploys a full-width student MLP but ties training to a teacher-induced slice, leaving 62.5-81.4% of each deployed matrix's independent linear degrees of freedom unreachable-paid for at inference, never trainable. Our principle is one line: train what you deploy. From the identical LRC warm start, we make the training object the entire deployed matrix, with no change in deployed shape, deployed parameter count, or inference FLOPs, via two mergeable realizations (Dense-LRC and CORE-LRC) that both collapse to one deployed weight. This recovers stranded capacity: taking the stronger realization per teacher, +2.36/+2.71/+10.45 Avg9 over matched-budget plain-LRC baselines across three teachers (Llama3.2-3B, Llama3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-3B), with the largest gain on the widest teacher (Qwen), where it reaches the original recipe's approx. 20B-token accuracy at 10B tokens (2x token efficiency); there the strictly same-lineage arm still recovers +6.39, the fully controlled figure. Controls strongly support attributing the gain to the enlarged reachable set, rather than to added parameters or the recipe. From approx. 10B distillation tokens plus a short SFT, a half-parameter 1.5B student matches its approx. 9T-token teacher's 9-task macro-average, within evaluation noise and with a residual MMLU deficit, and a 2.7B student beats Meta's own official compression of Llama3.1-8B at ~900x fewer compression tokens (a token count under unmatched recipes, not a compute claim). All results are from single-seed runs on the LRC backbone.
articles.titleCn: 训练你所部署的：在低秩克隆蒸馏中关闭MLP可达性差距
articles.abstractCn: 一个压缩学生模型存在两种形状，它们不必一致：模型在推理时部署的权重和其训练可达到的权重家族。我们证明了一种最先进的权重继承蒸馏器Low-Rank Clone (LRC)，部署了全宽度的学生MLP，但其训练被绑定到教师诱导的切片，导致每个部署矩阵的独立线性自由度中有62.5-81.4%无法触及——这些自由度在推理时被支付，但永远无法训练。我们的原则只有一句话：训练你所部署的。从相同的LRC预热开始，我们将训练对象设置为整个部署矩阵，且部署形状、部署参数数量或推理FLOPs均无变化，通过两种可合并的实现（Dense-LRC和CORE-LRC），这两种实现都最终归结为单个部署权重。这恢复了被浪费的容量：针对每个教师选择更强的实现，在三个教师（Llama3.2-3B、Llama3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-3B）上，与匹配预算的plain-LRC基线相比，平均提升分别为+2.36/+2.71/+10.45，在最宽的教师（Qwen）上增益最大，在10B token时达到了原始配方近20B token的准确率（2倍token效率）；在该情况下，严格同源分支仍提升了+6.39，即完全受控的结果。控制实验强烈支持将增益归因于可达集的扩大，而非增加的参数或配方本身。从约10B蒸馏token加上一个简短的SFT，一个半参数1.5B学生模型在评估噪声范围内，且存在残差MMLU缺陷的情况下，达到了其约9T-token教师模型的9任务宏观平均；一个2.7B学生模型在约900倍更少的压缩token下（这些token数在未匹配的配方下，并非计算声明）超越了Meta自己官方压缩的Llama3.1-8B。所有结果均来自在LRC主干上的单种子运行。

articles.title: NS-Copilot: An LLM-Driven Agent System for Autonomous Neuroscience Analysis
articles.abstract: AI is rapidly advancing neuroscience, yet many laboratories fail to fully unleash its potential due to significant interdisciplinary barriers. While pre-trained neural models for physiological data are progressing quickly, their heterogeneous architectures and modality-specific constraints hinder systematic integration, selection, and evaluation. Despite recent advances in large language model (LLM)-based agent systems for intelligent scientific applications, existing approaches often still lack the domain expertise required to effectively select and coordinate diverse neuroscience pre-trained models and handle unique data types in this domain. We present NS-Copilot, an LLM-driven multi-agent system for neuroscience analysis that autonomously supports end-to-end workflows for diverse professional tasks. It unifies domain-specific pre-trained models and supports key neuroscience modalities, including EEG and extracellular spike data, through a natural-language interface. Given raw data and a task description, NS-Copilot orchestrates agents with specialized roles for planning, adaptive control, code generation, and result synthesis, enabling analysis without dataset-specific heuristics. We evaluate NS-Copilot on neuroscience benchmarks spanning Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and working memory spike decoding. Across 8 trials per task, the system consistently outperforms strong baselines on the primary metric, demonstrating the ability of NS-Copilot for effective and scalable neuroscience analysis.

articles.titleCn: NS-Copilot：一个用于自主神经科学分析的LLM驱动智能体系统
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能正迅速推动神经科学的发展，然而许多实验室由于显著的跨学科壁垒未能充分释放其潜力。尽管用于生理数据的预训练神经模型进展迅速，但其异构架构和模态特定约束阻碍了系统的集成、选择和评估。尽管基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能科学应用代理系统近年来取得了进展，但现有方法通常仍缺乏领域专业知识，无法有效选择和协调多样的神经科学预训练模型以及处理该领域的独特数据类型。我们提出了NS-Copilot，这是一个用于神经科学分析的LLM驱动多代理系统，能够自主支持多样化专业任务的全流程工作流。它通过自然语言界面统一了领域特定的预训练模型，并支持关键的神经科学模态，包括脑电图（EEG）和细胞外尖峰数据。给定原始数据和任务描述，NS-Copilot会协调具有专门角色的代理进行规划、自适应控制、代码生成和结果合成，从而实现无需特定数据集启发式的分析。我们在涵盖阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和工作记忆尖峰解码的神经科学基准上评估了NS-Copilot。在每个任务中进行的8次试验中，该系统在主要指标上始终优于强基线，证明了NS-Copilot在有效和可扩展的神经科学分析方面的能力。
